accepted.workload_contract: gateway health plus one CRUD request
accepted.hypothesis: Killing the api-gateway pod will cause the entire pet/owner/visit flow to fail, as it is the entrypoint for all HTTP requests.
accepted.expected_invariant: The API gateway should remain available and respond to health checks and CRUD requests.
accepted.validation_plan: Send health check and a sample CRUD request to the gateway; expect successful responses before and after the fault.
accepted.recovery_expectation: The pod will be restarted automatically by Kubernetes, and the gateway should recover within a few seconds.
accepted.weakness_surface: The api-gateway is a single point of entry; without it, no requests can reach the backend services.
